collision_at_fault: I was merging onto {road} and didn't see {other_vehicle} in my blind spot. I clipped its rear quarter panel and my front bumper cracked.
Traffic stopped suddenly on {road} and I couldn't brake in time. I rear-ended {other_vehicle}. Nobody was hurt but my hood is bent.
Backing out of a space at {store}, I hit a parked car behind me. I left a note and called it in.
I was turning left onto {street} and misjudged the gap. {other_vehicle} hit my passenger side. The police came and I got a ticket for failure to yield.
I looked down at my phone for a second at a light on {street} and rolled into the car in front. Low speed, but its bumper and my grille are damaged.
Pulling out of the {store} lot, I didn't see {other_vehicle} coming and we collided. My front end and their driver's door are dented.
It was raining and my {vehicle} slid on {road} when I braked. I hit the back of {other_vehicle}. Both airbags went off in my car.

I changed lanes on {road} without enough room and sideswiped {other_vehicle}. Long scrape down both cars.
Parking in my garage, I hit the gas instead of the brake and went into the wall. Front bumper and headlight are broken.
I was tired after a late shift and drifted onto the shoulder of {road}, hitting a guardrail. The car is drivable but the right side is crushed.
I was distracted by my GPS in {city} and ran into the back of a car stopped at a crosswalk on {street}.
Making a U-turn on {street}, I didn't see a car coming from behind a truck. We hit hard and both cars were towed.
collision_not_at_fault: I was stopped at a red light on {street} when {other_vehicle} rear-ended me. The other driver said they were looking at their phone.
My {vehicle} was parked on {street} overnight. In the morning the driver's side was caved in and there was no note.
{other_vehicle} ran a stop sign at {street} and hit my front passenger side. The police report says the other driver was at fault.
I was driving on {road} when {other_vehicle} changed lanes into me. It scraped my whole left side and kept going.
Someone backed into my car in the {store} parking lot while I was inside. A witness got their plate number.
I was waiting to turn into the school pickup line when {other_vehicle} hit me from behind.
A driver ran the red light at {street} and T-boned me. I was taken to urgent care to get checked out.
{other_vehicle} merged onto {road} without looking and pushed me into the median barrier.
My car was parked at a gas station on {road} when {other_vehicle} pulling up to the next pump hit my rear door.
I was stopped in traffic on {road} and got hit from behind, which pushed me into the car in front. Three cars involved.
Coming home on {street}, a car pulled out of a driveway without looking and hit my front bumper.
While I was parked outside {store}, a delivery truck clipped my mirror and front fender making a tight turn.
collision_shared: Two of us were changing into the same lane on {road} at the same time and our cars touched. The police couldn't say who was first.
I was turning left on a green at {street}, and {other_vehicle} came through on a yellow. We both could have waited.
In the {store} parking lot, I was backing out and so was the car behind me. We backed into each other.
The light at {street} was out and the intersection was a four-way stop. {other_vehicle} and I went at the same time.
I braked for a dog on {street} and {other_vehicle} was following too close. The officer said we both share some blame.
We were both trying to get into the last spot at {store}. I bumped their rear corner and they bumped my front.
Road construction on {road} had the lanes badly marked. {other_vehicle} and I drifted into each other where the lanes shifted.
I pulled out of a side street onto {street} and the other car was speeding. We collided in the middle of the road.
glass: A rock kicked up by {other_vehicle} on {road} hit my windshield. The chip turned into a crack across the driver's side.
My windshield cracked overnight after a cold snap. It started from a small chip I got on {road} last week.
Driving behind a gravel truck on {road}, something hit the windshield and cracked it right in my line of sight.
I found a long crack across the windshield of my {vehicle} in the morning. Nothing else is damaged.
A stone from road work on {road} chipped the windshield. The chip is larger than a quarter, so the shop says it can't be repaired.
Someone threw a golf ball over the fence on {street} and it cracked my windshield while I was parked.
My rear window shattered while I was driving on {road}. I don't know what hit it.
A tree branch fell on my windshield in the {store} parking lot. The glass is cracked but the roof is fine.
Small chip on the passenger side of the windshield from {road} that has spread to about eight inches.
The windshield of my {vehicle} cracked from the heat after I parked in the sun all afternoon. It started from an old chip.
Rock hit the windshield on {road} near {city}. Now there's a star-shaped crack, and it's getting longer.
weather: A hailstorm came through {city} while my car was parked on {street}. The hood and roof are covered in dents.

A heavy storm knocked a tree limb onto my car in the driveway. The roof and rear window are damaged.
Flash flooding on {street} came up to the doors while I was parked. Water got inside and the engine won't start.
Strong winds blew a neighbor's trampoline into my car. Scratches and dents along the passenger side.

I came out of {store} and my tires had been slashed. All four are flat.
Someone broke my passenger window in the {store} parking lot and took a backpack and sunglasses.
My car was spray-painted while parked outside my apartment on {street}.
Somebody kicked in my side mirrors and dented the hood while the car was parked downtown in {city}.
The rear window of my {vehicle} was smashed overnight. Nothing was taken.

Eggs and rocks thrown at my car overnight on {street}. Paint is chipped and one headlight is broken.

theft: My {vehicle} was stolen from my driveway on {street} overnight. I've filed a police report.

Someone stole my car from the {store} parking lot. I had a spare key hidden in it, which I shouldn't have.

A fire in my neighbor's garage spread to my car parked next to it on {street}.
Smoke came out of the dashboard while I was parked at {store}. By the time help came the front of the car was burned out.

Electrical fire under the hood after I jump-started the car. The engine compartment is badly burned.
My car caught fire after I drove over debris on {road}. The fire started under the car.
